crossRefs.note: Foolish Galatians, who has bewitched you not to obey the truth, before whose eyes Jesus Christ was openly portrayed…
You yourselves also know, you Philippians, that in the beginning of the Good News, when I departed from Macedonia, no…
I say this not to condemn you, for I have said before that you are in our hearts to die together and live together.
Great is my boldness of speech toward you. Great is my boasting on your behalf. I am filled with comfort. I overflow…
Hannah prayed, and said: “My heart exults in Yahweh! My horn is exalted in Yahweh. My mouth is enlarged over my…
I will speak, that I may be refreshed. I will open my lips and answer.
See now, I have opened my mouth. My tongue has spoken in my mouth.
My words will utter the uprightness of my heart. That which my lips know they will speak sincerely.
Lord, open my lips. My mouth will declare your praise.
For out of much affliction and anguish of heart I wrote to you with many tears, not that you should be made to grieve…
I will most gladly spend and be spent for your souls. If I love you more abundantly, am I loved the less?
I run in the path of your commandments, for you have set my heart free.
Yes, moreover, wine is treacherous. An arrogant man who doesn’t stay at home, who enlarges his desire as Sheol, and he…
knowing that whatever good thing each one does, he will receive the same good again from the Lord, whether he is bound…
For God is my witness, how I long after all of you in the tender mercies of Christ Jesus.
“Behold, I come quickly. My reward is with me, to repay to each man according to his work.

people.name: Corinth
people.line: Ancient Greek city; recipient of Paul's epistles

translations.web: Our mouth is open to you, Corinthians. Our heart is enlarged.
translations.bsb: We have spoken freely to you, Corinthians. Our hearts are open wide.
translations.kjv: O ye Corinthians, our mouth is open unto you, our heart is enlarged.
translations.asv: Our mouth is open unto you, O Corinthians, our heart is enlarged.
